Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling in the center lane of a multi-lane roadway in Pasadena, Texas, when Driver 1 signaled and
moved toward the right lane. Driver 2, operating a vehicle in that lane, was alongside and the two vehicles made
contact along their sides, producing a sideswipe collision. The point of contact on Driver 1's vehicle is consistent with
the damage observed on both vehicles, and the damage pattern matches the impact described by each driver. Driver
2 stated that the collision occurred as Driver 1 described, and two independent witnesses gave accounts that agree
with both drivers. Photographs taken at the scene show the same damage and positions of the vehicles. No prior
damage to Driver 1's vehicle was noted during inspection. Driver 1 reported neck and back pain at the scene and was
transported for evaluation. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the policy. A passenger was present in the
vehicle, but the exact seating position of the claimant at impact could not be fully confirmed from the information
available. Injuries reported are consistent with the type and force of the collision.
